$comment: Placeable stations, GAME_DESIGN.md section 8. Stations.ts contains no literals.
$comment_provides: Service names are what the systems ask for, so adding a station that also cooks is a data change. 'craft1' is the workbench tier-1 gate; tier 2 additionally needs a roof, which is the M4 job.
$comment_sleep: Sleeping skips to morning if nearby threats are clear. 'Clear' means no aggressive pal inside this radius.
$comment_revive: A campfire revives fainted pals one at a time, 30s each, per section 8.
